description: The running databases, read-only: their servers and databases (servers), one database's schema (schema), a table's first rows (rows), a query's rows (query: Postgres's, in a read-only transaction). Secret-looking columns are masked here.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

container.description: schema, rows, query: the server's container.

sql.description: query: one statement that reads (SELECT, WITH, VALUES, TABLE), run read-only; its rows come back as rows' do, secret-looking columns masked, QUERY_ROWS_MAX of them at most.
